title: CommunityMeasurementBatch
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Batch of interval measurement readings (int:CommunityMeasurement) for a single Community. All fields other than timestamp are optional since not every metering point captures every quantity.

communityId.description: FK to the Community these measurements belong to.

items.description: A single interval measurement reading for a Community (int:CommunityMeasurement).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the measurements are recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone.

energyIn.description: Average amount of energy imported per interval.

energyOut.description: Average amount of energy exported per interval.
